title: Shapes as a union
description:
Use a discriminated union instead of classes.

```
circle r=2       area 12.57
rect 3x4         area 12.00
triangle 3,4,5   area 6.00
Total: 30.57
```
hints: A triangle's area from three sides is Heron's formula: with `p = (a + b + c) / 2`, the area is `Math.sqrt(p * (p - a) * (p - b) * (p - c))`.
`default: { const unreachable: never = s; throw new Error(String(unreachable)); }` only compiles while every kind has a case.
requirements: `type Shape = Circle | Rect | Triangle`, each with a `kind` field.
`area(s: Shape): number` and `label(s: Shape): string` use `switch (s.kind)`.
Add a `default` case with a `never` check so adding a new shape without handling it is a compile error.
stretch: Add a `scale(s: Shape, factor: number): Shape` that keeps the same kind.
